text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! How was it? My running?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I think I stood out a decent 
amount.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the real deal is just beginning! 
The path the President walked—the Classic 
races!”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You said "today's race is just a stepping 
stone," right? So next time is the real 
deal...

The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown 
to determine the pinnacle of the 
generation—a race Tokai Teio had been 
yearning to run—
choice_data_list: You're running in the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Here it is! Just hearing the name of that 
race gets my heart pounding~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know, when Prez won the Satsuki Sho, 
she held up one finger to celebrate!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna win too and make the same 
statement! I'm aiming to be a "Triple 
Crown Umamusume"~!!

Having safely completed the Wakagoma 
Stakes, the challenge for the Classic 
races begins!!
